info.title: FetchX customer API
info.description: The managed customer API uses /v2. Provisioned project Bearer tokens retain their approved v2 and v1 APIs. Provisioned native submissions, v1 workflows and jobs, and the website control plane have separate reference material. API major versions, service releases and immutable profile or recipe versions are separate.

post.summary: Check a managed Render target and get its browser profile
post.description: Managed fxk_ keys only. Runs the Playground's browser policy for one public HTTPS URL and proxy. It does not resolve or contact the source, reserve credits or create a profile record. When ready is true, submit the returned url and access_profile with the same proxy and a new idempotency key to POST /v2/render.

200.description: Preparation result. Inspect errors when ready is false.

403.description: Managed key required or scope missing

post.summary: Render a page in a dedicated browser session
post.description: Opens an approved HTTPS page with GET in a dedicated browser session. Render requires a qualified runtime and an approved browser profile and route. Managed projects use the Render profile issued by their playground for the selected destination and need approved browser credit weights. Check features.browser_render in GET /v2/capabilities. This endpoint accepts an optional wait and viewport screenshot.

post.summary: Render one page and convert its retained DOM
post.description: Requires an enabled project-specific route or operator-reviewed managed Direct Scrape. Managed keys need fetch:write and use the existing project-bound public HTTPS Playground browser policy and operation credits. Saved captures replay by the original X-Idempotency-Key even when new Scrape admission is disabled; project and key authorization still apply.

ProjectBearer.description: Project Bearer credential. Managed fxk_ keys need the operation’s x-managed-key-scope. Scopes limit API actions. Approved destinations, profiles, routes and spending still apply.

provider.description: Effective provider identifier. A direct route reports direct.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated durable key. Save it before submitting. A changed request under a bound key returns 409.

access_profile.description: Approved access profile reference with its immutable version. Required for provisioned projects. For managed fxk_ keys, omitting it selects public-url-http version 1 when that paid public URL profile is available to the project.

url.description: Approved absolute HTTPS destination. Profile rules restrict origin, path and method.

oneOf.description: Explicit proxy class and country. Use null for direct or an approved uppercase country for a proxied route.

proxy.description: Explicit proxy class and country. Use null for direct or an approved uppercase country for a proxied route. Use {"class": "auto"} to let FetchX choose and escalate.

max_estimated_micro_usd.description: Optional conservative spending ceiling in micro-USD. Admission fails when the estimate exceeds it or cannot be guaranteed.

session_id.description: Optional existing HTTP session with the same profile version, proxy class and country.

headers.description: Only source headers approved for this destination. Keep gateway credentials and cookies out of these values.

body_base64.description: Canonical base64 for the native request body, subject to the profile limit. Omit or set null for GET or HEAD.

retry.description: Opt in to the gateway’s bounded retry for eligible pristine HTTP reads on a dedicated datacenter route. It never authorizes retry of uncertain or stateful work. Paid routes reject retry: true.

max_transfer_mb.description: Paid HTTP only. Bidirectional wire ceiling in decimal MB, in 0.25 MB steps. Omit on Public URL HTTP to size the reservation from the available balance, max_credits and the transfer limits. Supplying it on an eligible direct or datacenter profile selects paid billing.

max_credits.description: Paid HTTP only. Positive cap on the prepaid credits the gateway may reserve for this request. Admission fails with max_credits_exceeded when the reservation needs more.

max_attempts.description: Auto mode only: the most attempts that reach the site. Steps refused at admission cost nothing and do not count.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated durable key. Save it before submitting. A changed request under a bound key returns 409.

access_profile.description: Approved access profile reference with its immutable version.

url.description: Approved absolute HTTPS destination. Profile rules restrict origin, path and method.

proxy.description: Explicit proxy class and country. Use null for direct or an approved uppercase country for a proxied route.

max_estimated_micro_usd.description: Optional conservative spending ceiling in micro-USD. Admission fails when the estimate exceeds it or cannot be guaranteed.

screenshot.description: Capture a viewport JPEG of at most 1 MiB when approved and available.

wait_ms.description: Post-load wait in milliseconds for client-side rendering to settle, limited by the access profile's max_wait_ms. Omission uses the profile default.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Handle unknown codes conservatively.

message.description: Safe human-readable description. Branch on code.

stage.description: Stage at which the failure was reported.

details.description: Optional structured guidance. source_challenge reports the vendor and HTTP status; source_cooldown reports the origin and its expiry. On a Public URL transfer cutoff it reports max_transfer_mb, max_allowed_transfer_mb, reserved_credits and, when a larger ceiling is possible, next.max_transfer_mb and next.max_credits for a new operation with a new idempotency key.

safe_to_retry.description: Whether the gateway can suggest a deliberate new source request, subject to the other conditions here.

same_key_replay_safe.description: Whether an identical submission using the caller key can recover an existing operation without redispatching it. An unbound key can still admit work.

new_request_allowed.description: Whether this result permits consideration of new source work.

next_action.description: Suggested caller action. Use read-only recovery when uncertain. Known values include complete, recover_by_key, check_url, review_source_access, wait_for_source_retry_after, consider_approved_residential_fresh_session (Fetch), consider_residential_new_request (Render), review_proxy_configuration, review_transfer_limit and retry_same_key.

lookup_url.description: Relative read-only recovery URL, when available.

retry_after.description: Seconds or an HTTP date to wait before a new request. Also reported with source_challenge and source_forbidden when the source or a FetchX cooldown sets a wait.

requested.description: Fetch reported on an explicitly requested bounded gateway retry.

attempts.description: Number of gateway attempts in the retained retry evidence.

requires_render_preparation.description: Render only. Call POST /v2/render/prepare for the suggested route before the new request, to get its profile and quote.

status.description: Source HTTP status. It can be null and is independent of gateway_http_status.

final_url.description: Final source URL in the retained evidence, if known.

body_base64.description: Retained decoded response bytes for Fetch or generated UTF-8 DOM bytes for Render.

text.description: Retained UTF-8 text, when available. Treat HTML as inert content.

retry_after.description: The source Retry-After value, if retained. It may be a delay or an HTTP date.

headers.description: Allowlisted source response headers. This excludes cookies and credential headers.

kind.description: Evidence kind such as native_response, download, browser_response, rendered_dom or browser_screenshot.

status.description: Source status associated with this evidence, when available.

attempt.description: Fetch attempt number when the gateway retained retry evidence.

content_type.description: Present for an included Render viewport screenshot.

body_base64.description: Included viewport JPEG for a retained screenshot when available.

state.description: Reservation state, such as reserved, settled, held or released.

estimated_micro_usd.description: Conservative configured estimate. Null means no guarantee is available.

invoice_micro_usd.description: Authoritatively reconciled provider invoice amount, if known.

customer_traffic_reservation.description: Conservative customer traffic reservation, when available.

accounting.description: Provider accounting, conservative estimates and managed request credits where applicable.

native_requests.description: Known native HTTP requests. Null for Render.

byte_basis.description: What the byte counters measure. Measurements and reservations are separate from invoices.

wire_bytes.description: Paid HTTP only. Complete local observation of bidirectional wire bytes, including TLS, CONNECT, DNS over HTTPS and redirects, when available.

wire_bytes_lower_bound.description: Paid HTTP only. Confirmed wire bytes.

accounting.description: Provider accounting, conservative estimates and managed request credits where applicable.

native_requests.description: Known native HTTP requests. Null for Render.

byte_basis.description: What the byte counters measure. Measurements and reservations are separate from invoices.

blocked_reasons.description: Count of page requests the browser policy blocked, by reason.

subresource_origins.description: Number of other public origins the page loaded subresources from.

success.description: Whether FetchX obtained a successful source result. HTTP 200 alone does not establish this.

state.description: Durable operation state, or rejected for many admission failures. Reserved, running or unknown results require recovery.

gateway_http_status.description: HTTP status of the gateway response. Retained operations use 200 even when the source denied access or capture is incomplete.

idempotency_key.description: Caller key for facade submission and key lookup. An operation-ID projection can show a native key or null.

idempotency_key_scope.description: caller, native_operation or internal_operation, when available. Only caller keys can be used for same-key facade replay.

internal_idempotency_key.description: Internal operation key in an operation-ID projection. It cannot be used as the original caller key.

data.description: Retained source data. Can be null before evidence is available.

artifacts.description: Retained evidence references. GET /v2/artifacts/{id} retrieves a full project-owned artifact.

diagnostics.description: Safe diagnostics, when available. Fields vary by failure stage and transport.

error.description: Structured gateway or source failure when present. Retained failures can have gateway HTTP 200.

application_acceptance.description: The caller decides whether the retained evidence satisfies its application.

supported.description: Fetch capabilities reported in a structured failure.

auto.description: Auto mode summary. When the final attempt was a rendered browser, data and usage follow the render response shape.

supported.description: Render response shape marker reported in a structured failure. This does not guarantee availability.

engine.description: Browser engine that served the render, for example camoufox.

browser.description: Engine and version that served the render, when known.

details.description: Additional safe information when provided by the gateway.

diagnostics.description: Safe diagnostics, when available. Fields vary by failure stage and transport.

browser.description: Native transport field. Read features.browser_render to check the separate Render facade.

browser_network_probe.description: Native browser probe availability for provisioned projects.

browser_render.description: Whether Render is currently available for this project. For managed keys this uses the Playground's browser route checks, including runtime, reviewed route pricing and route health. Use POST /v2/render/prepare for a target-specific check.

discovery_profile_policy.description: Additional provisioned discovery limits are included when configured.

capability_scope.description: The capability view is for the authenticated project.

paid_http.description: Managed projects only. Paid HTTP readiness.

public_url_access_profiles.description: Present when extended Public URL coverage is ready.

subresources.description: public lets the page load scripts, styles, images, fonts and data calls from other public origins within the caps.

page_post.description: Whether the page's own XHR or fetch POSTs (up to 64 KiB) may be sent.

browser_probe.description: Native browser probe limits when applicable. For managed projects use the Render profile issued by the playground.

kind.description: Present for discovery and public_url_http profiles.

max_daily_operations.description: Public URL HTTP profiles only. Paid daily operation quota, if configured.

state.description: Durable operation state such as reserved, running, completed, failed or unknown.

error.description: Native operation error code, if present. See source status independently.

idempotency_key.description: Stored native operation key. Fetch or Render facade operations use an internal key here.

retry_after.description: The source Retry-After value, if retained. It may be a delay or an HTTP date.

diagnostics.description: Safe diagnostics, when available. Fields vary by failure stage and transport.

extracted.description: Native recipe outputs, when evaluated. Keys are recipe-specific.

partial.description: Only part of the evidence was retained. Unknown work must be recovered before sending a new request.

result.description: Retained native result metadata. The transport determines additional fields.

state.description: Durable operation state such as reserved, running, completed, failed or unknown.

error.description: Native operation error code, if present. See source status independently.

diagnostics.description: Safe diagnostics, when available. Fields vary by failure stage and transport.

paid_credits.description: Managed projects only. Prepaid credit balance.

credit_balance.description: Present when trial and purchased credits share one balance.

kind.description: Evidence kind such as native_response, download, browser_response, rendered_dom or browser_screenshot.

status.description: Source status associated with this evidence, when available.

headers.description: Retained source or generated artifact headers. Treat full artifact contents as sensitive.

PaidCreditQuote.description: Prepaid credit reservation for one billing block or the requested ceiling.

PaidCreditAttribution.description: Prepaid credits reserved and settled for this operation.

state.description: Reservation state, such as reserved, held, settled or released.

ready.description: True when the returned profile, route and quote can be used now. Admission checks again before dispatch.

url.description: Normalized target to submit to POST /v2/render.

waitFor.description: Additional settle time in milliseconds, subject to the access profile limit.

timeout.description: Requested browser operation deadline in milliseconds, capped by the access profile and existing dispatch limits.

ChallengeDetails.description: Reported with source_challenge. The page was a bot-manager interstitial; a challenge page wins over its HTTP status, including 403 and 429.

vendor.description: Protection vendor when the passive classifier can attribute it, otherwise unknown.

CooldownDetails.description: Reported with source_cooldown. FetchX holds new requests to this origin until cooldown_until.

AutoProxySelection.description: Auto mode: FetchX picks the route. It starts from what worked for the host, then climbs cheapest first through HTTP direct, datacenter and residential, a rendered browser on residential, a fresh residential session (new IP), and a browser on datacenter, within the access profile and provider rules. Only GET and HEAD escalate (browser steps are GET only). Only the attempt that succeeds is billed.

country.description: Optional preferred country. Defaults to the country that worked for the host, else US.

rotation.description: Present on a repeat of the same route on a fresh session (new IP).

code.description: Admission code when the step was not admitted or was waited out.

AutoSummary.description: Present when proxy.class was auto. Never names providers or protection vendors.

billed_attempt.description: Which dispatched attempt was billed; null when nothing was billed.

headers_adjusted.description: Headers FetchX fixed, such as an automation User-Agent replaced with a browser one.
